R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if grid[r][c]==7 or (r,c) in seen: continue
  stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
  while stack:
   x,y=stack.pop(); comp.append((x,y))

     seen.add((nx,ny)); stack.append((nx,ny))
  comps.append(comp)
out=[row[:] for row in grid]

 colors={grid[r][c] for r,c in co}
